questions.q: Which HTTP method does Oracle Fusion's REST API use to create a brand-new invoice?
questions.explain: POST creates a new resource at the collection URL.

questions.q: A GET request to /invoices/300000182 and a PATCH request to the same URL target the same resource. What's different?
options: Nothing — they do the exact same thing
GET reads the invoice without changing it; PATCH updates part of it
GET deletes the invoice; PATCH creates a new one
PATCH can only be used on collections, never single resources
questions.explain: The URL stays the same; the method determines whether it's a read or an update.

questions.q: What does a status code in the 4xx range generally indicate?
options: The server had an unexpected internal failure
Something about the request itself (credentials, data, permissions) needs to be fixed
The API is permanently shut down
questions.explain: 4xx codes point back at the request — bad data, bad auth, or no permission.

questions.q: Which status code specifically means a resource could not be found?
questions.explain: 404 means the requested resource doesn't exist at that URL.

questions.q: A call returns a 500 status code. What does that tell you?
options: Your request body had a typo
Something failed on the server's side, not necessarily something wrong with your request
questions.explain: 5xx codes indicate a server-side failure rather than a problem with the request itself.
